overfit.code:
torch.manual_seed(0)
m = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(6, 24), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3),
                  nn.Linear(24, 24), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(24, 5), nn.Softmax(dim=1))
o = torch.optim.SGD(m.parameters(), lr=0.05, momentum=0.9)
xb, yb = Xtr[:16], ytr[:16]                                # one small batch
for step in range(201):
    l = loss_fn(m(xb), yb); l.backward(); o.step()
    if step % 50 == 0: print(step, round(l.item(), 3))
